definition: Next scheduled FOMC meeting probability of target range above current range, equal, or below; percentage 0–100; one verified end-of-day snapshot per US trading date, with meeting date retained. No interpolation or estimated values.
notes: Only publish observations from sources permitting public redistribution; otherwise use authorized independently derived values with distinct methodology or leave blank.
Do not compare same-meeting changes across meeting rollovers without labeling the change. Preserve observation date, source, and publication timestamp.
